### Về LLM (Large Language Models)
1. **[Neuromodulatory Control Networks (NCNs): A Biologically Inspired Architecture for Dynamic LLM Processing](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17621804)** - Morgan, Michael Christian (2025)
2. **[From Prediction to Precision: Leveraging LLMs for Equitable and Data-Driven Writing Placement in Developmental Education](https://doi.org/10.4230/oasics.slate.2025.1)** - Da Corte, Miguel, Baptista, Jorge (2025)
3. **[DeepSeek-R1 incentivizes reasoning in LLMs through reinforcement learning](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-09422-z.pdf)** - Daya Guo, Dejian Yang, Haowei Zhang et al. (2025)
4. **[The TRIPOD-LLM reporting guideline for studies using large language models](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41591-024-03425-5)** - Jack Gallifant, Majid Afshar, Saleem Ameen et al. (2025)
5. **[A systematic review of large language model (LLM) evaluations in clinical medicine](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12911-025-02954-4)** - Sina Shool, Sara Adimi, Reza Saboori Amleshi et al. (2025)
6. **[A framework to assess clinical safety and hallucination rates of LLMs for medical text summarisation](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41746-025-01670-7)** - Elham Asgari, Nina Montaña-Brown, Magda Dubois et al. (2025)
7. **[AWQ: Activation-aware Weight Quantization for On-Device LLM Compression and Acceleration](https://doi.org/10.1145/3714983.3714987)** - Ji Lin, Jiaming Tang, Haotian Tang et al. (2025)
8. **[When LLMs meet cybersecurity: a systematic literature review](https://doi.org/10.1186/s42400-025-00361-w)** - Jie Zhang, H. Bu, Hui Wen et al. (2025)
9. **[Expressing stigma and inappropriate responses prevents LLMs from safely replacing mental health providers](https://doi.org/10.1145/3715275.3732039)** - Jared Moore, Declan Grabb, William S. Agnew et al. (2025)
10. **[LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems for Software Engineering: Literature Review, Vision, and the Road Ahead](https://doi.org/10.1145/3712003)** - Junda He, Christoph Treude, David Lo (2025)

### Về VLM (Vision-Language Models)
1. **[IndVisSGG: VLM-based scene graph generation for industrial spatial intelligence](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.aei.2024.103107)** - Zuoxu Wang, Zhijie Yan, Shufei Li et al. (2025)
2. **[VLM-RL: A unified vision language models and reinforcement learning framework for safe autonomous driving](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.trc.2025.105321)** - Zilin Huang, Zihao Sheng, Yansong Qu et al. (2025)
3. **[VLM-MSGraph: Vision Language Model-enabled Multi-hierarchical Scene Graph for robotic assembly](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rcim.2025.102978)** - Shufei Li, Zhijie Yan, Zuoxu Wang et al. (2025)
4. **[MedVLM-R1: Incentivizing Medical Reasoning Capability of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) via Reinforcement Learning](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-032-04981-0_32)** - Jiazhen Pan, Che Liu, Junde Wu et al. (2025)
5. **[LogicAD: Explainable Anomaly Detection via VLM-based Text Feature Extraction](https://doi.org/10.1609/aaai.v39i4.32433)** - Er Jin, Qihui Feng, Yongli Mou et al. (2025)
6. **[V2X-VLM: End-to-End V2X cooperative autonomous driving through large vision-Language models](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.trc.2025.105457)** - Junwei You, Zhuoyu Jiang, Zilin Huang et al. (2025)
7. **[Rethinking VLMs and LLMs for image classification](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-025-04384-8)** - A. Feder Cooper, Keizo Kato, Chia-Hsien Shih et al. (2025)
8. **[FLAIR: VLM with Fine-grained Language-informed Image Representations](https://doi.org/10.1109/cvpr52734.2025.02317)** - Rui Xiao, Sanghwan Kim, Mariana-Iuliana Georgescu et al. (2025)
9. **[USER-VLM 360: Personalized Vision Language Models with User-aware Tuning for Social Human-Robot Interactions](https://doi.org/10.1145/3716553.3750767)** - Hamed Rahimi, Adil Bahaj, Mouad Abrini et al. (2025)
10. **[Overcoming Shortcut Problem in VLM for Robust Out-of-Distribution Detection](https://doi.org/10.1109/cvpr52734.2025.01435)** - Zhuo Xu, Xiang Xiang, Yifan Liang (2025)
